name: premkumar-portfolio
description: Editorial Portfolio for Premkumar V — AI Developer & Python Backend Developer

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Validating portfolio assets...'); const fs=require('fs'); ['index.html','assets/css/style.css','assets/js/main.js','assets/images/premkumar-cutout.png'].forEach(f => { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing: ' + f); console.log('✓ ' + f + ' ok'); }); console.log('Build complete: All portfolio files verified.');"
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('Testing JS syntax...'); require('./assets/js/main.js');" 2>/dev/null || node -c assets/js/main.js && echo '✓ JavaScript syntax test passed!'

author: Premkumar V
